\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-71},
  title = {Secrets are scanned with gitleaks before commit and in CI},
  date = {2026-10-05},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {CI/CD, Security},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {gitleaks scans every staged change in a pre-commit hook and the whole published history in a required CI job.
\texttt{.\allowbreak{}gitleaks.\allowbreak{}toml} adds one rule of our own for the DagsHub token.
A canary fails the CI job when the scan no longer finds planted tokens.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item detect-secrets: by default it finds the DagsHub token in 11 of 13 places, where gitleaks' defaults find it in 7, but it reads files and not history.
\item GitHub secret scanning: it has no DagsHub pattern and leaves nothing in the repository to review.
\item A Pytest grep of the working tree: sees only the latest commit.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The repository is public, so a secret in any pushed commit is published even if the next commit deletes it.
Only a scan of the history catches a commit that skipped the hook.
The detection gap of gitleaks closes with one rule in a file we own: with it, every planted token is found in all 13 places.
The history gap of detect-secrets cannot be closed.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted with modifications},
  assessment = {AI recommended gitleaks partly because detect-secrets would detect worse.
Measured, that was false, so the choice rests on the history argument alone.
An independent AI review then found two blind spots, merge commits and a canary that could not fail, and both were fixed before merging.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-05 on issue \#60.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/60}{Issue \#60}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/70}{PR \#70}, \texttt{.\allowbreak{}gitleaks.\allowbreak{}toml}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/analysis/secret_scan_dagshub_token_results.txt}{\texttt{secret\_\allowbreak{}scan\_\allowbreak{}dagshub\_\allowbreak{}token\_\allowbreak{}results.\allowbreak{}txt}}.},
}
